basics.name: Sathya Narayana Bhat
basics.label: Security Operations & Detection Engineer
basics.summary: Cybersecurity Engineer with 4+ years in SIEM engineering, detection tuning, and incident response across multi-cloud environments (AWS/GCP). Built and operated SIEM platforms (Wazuh, Google Security Operations), authored incident response playbooks for WAF and SIEM events, piloted SOAR workflows (Shuffle, Windmill) for response automation, and trained L1 SOC analysts to handle critical incidents. Cut alert false positives by ~30% and reduced high/critical vulnerability findings by 75-80%. Offensive background in VAPT and adversarial AI/LLM testing (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS) informs detection design, and DevSecOps experience (Kubernetes, Terraform, Python) supports building automation that reduces analyst toil.

work.name: Indsys holdings
work.position: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer - DevSecOps & Cloud Security
work.summary: As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer at Indsys holdings, I led security operations spanning network penetration testing, perimeter hardening, telemetry, and cloud infrastructure - strengthening the organization's security posture across on-premise and cloud environments.
highlights: Performed end-to-end Network VAPT for clients encompassing reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, manual exploitation, and risk-rated remediation reporting.
Designed and implemented network firewall rules and segmentation policies for on-premises infrastructure, hardening the network perimeter and controlling internal access paths.
Instrumented Java and Python applications with OpenTelemetry and deployed the Grafana LGTM stack, delivering unified metrics, logs, and traces for improved visibility across services.
Managed and optimized AWS cloud infrastructure for company services, achieving ~25-30% cost reduction through resource rightsizing, reserved instances, and usage audits.
Architected and implemented CI/CD pipelines for monolithic and microservice applications, streamlining deployment workflows and reducing release cycle time.

Architected and operated a proof-of-concept multi-tenant ERPNext platform on a self-managed Kubernetes cluster, achieving per-tenant compute and storage isolation using ArgoCD ApplicationSets and Helm for GitOps-driven tenant onboarding.

work.name: IDfy
work.position: Senior Information Security Engineer - DevSecOps & Cloud Security
work.summary: As a Senior Information Security Engineer at IDfy, I scaled SIEM coverage, tuned edge detections, and drove security automation across CI/CD and multi-cloud infrastructure, while standardizing the team's AI/LLM security review process.
highlights: Enhanced multi-cloud SIEM with automated asset onboarding, reducing manual provisioning effort and improving detection coverage.

Investigated alerts and conducted proactive threat hunts in Google Security Operations (Chronicle) using UDM search across GCP and Cloud Armor telemetry, feeding findings into detection tuning and incident response.
Reduced false positives in Google Cloud Armor (WAF) alerts by ~30% through detection tuning and signature refinement.
Supported SOC 2 Type 2 audit by providing evidence for SIEM, vulnerability management, and incident response controls.
Implemented network-layer geo-fencing across company services and applications, reducing inbound attack surface from out-of-scope regions.
Implemented a CI compliance scanner running across all company repositories, surfacing policy drift early in the SDLC and shifting security left in the delivery pipeline.

Designed an internal AI security framework defining assessment triggers, threat models, and adversarial testing protocols for LLM-integrated features, and led hands-on testing for prompt injection, prompt leakage, training data poisoning, and model evasion aligned with OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.

work.name: IDfy
work.summary: As an Information Security Engineer at IDfy, I built and operated the organization's core security operations platforms - centralized SIEM, incident response, and vulnerability management - while mentoring SOC analysts and partnering with engineering teams on secure-by-default practices.
highlights: Built and operated a centralized multi-cloud Wazuh SIEM across AWS and GCP, tuning detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and providing endpoint monitoring through file integrity monitoring, configuration assessment, and active response.
Investigated and responded to escalated security incidents, leading root cause analysis and implementing corrective measures, including detection and process improvements, to prevent recurrence.
Trained and mentored L1 SOC analysts on triage and escalation, enabling them to handle critical cybersecurity incidents with speed and precision.
Authored incident response playbooks for Web Application Firewall (WAF) and SIEM events.
Piloted SOAR workflows (Shuffle, Windmill.dev) to automate incident response tasks.
Performed vulnerability assessments across company assets, reducing high/critical severity findings by 75-80%.
Developed and maintained custom security scripts and tooling to automate routine operational tasks.
Collaborated with development teams to ensure secure coding practices and adherence to security standards.
Conducted regular information security training sessions for company employees.

work.name: IDfy
work.summary: Performed comprehensive vulnerability assessments (VAPT) on critical applications, identifying and mitigating potential risks.
highlights: Collaborated with development teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities.
Provided detailed vulnerability reports with remediation recommendations.
Enhanced communication and collaboration between security and development teams.

projects.name: Personal Homelab - K3s Cluster
highlights: Self-hosted production-grade K3s cluster running media, automation, and LLM services with GitOps-driven continuous deployment via ArgoCD.
Designed cluster networking and ingress with Cloudflare Tunnels for zero-trust external access, eliminating public port exposure while routing traffic securely to internal services.
Managed persistent storage and volume provisioning for stateful workloads, with all service configurations version-controlled and reconciled automatically via ArgoCD.
Deployed and operated self-hosted LLMs (Gemma 4B, Bonsai-4B on Ollama) as a personal automation backbone integrated with homelab services.
Tech Stack: K3s, ArgoCD, Cloudflare Tunnels, Helm/Kustomize, Ollama

projects.name: Vaultify
highlights: Built a CLI-based secret manager for an IDfy hackathon that securely injects secrets into environment variables during local development without Docker or cloud KMS.
Security-by-design: secrets stored only in encrypted form and the master key never written to disk.
Wrote documentation and setup scripts enabling developer onboarding within minutes.
Tech Stack: Python, Redis, Flask

projects.name: Automated Resume Pipeline
highlights: Designed a GitHub Actions pipeline that renders a JSON-sourced resume to PDF on every commit, with dependency caching, schema validation, HTML-to-PDF conversion, and versioned GitHub Release publication.
Forked and customized a jsonresume theme to meet ATS and visual requirements.
Tech Stack: GitHub Actions, Node.js, jsonresume, HTML/CSS
